move: circular photo irises open, lines rise through masks, stamp spins in
how: A cream 1080 square with a large circular photo (clip-path circle), two uppercase lines and an italic pill line stacked over it, a round stamp and a brand footer. The photo opens from clip-path circle(0%) to circle(50%) (expo.inOut, first 20%) while its image zooms 1.25 to 1 with a small rotate over the whole clip. Lines rise yPercent 110 to 0 (expo.out, 0.8s) at 10%, 13% and 17%, the pill also un-rotating from 6deg; the stamp scales from 0 with rotate -120 (back.out(1.8)) then turns slowly; the pill pulses scale 1.04 four times from 40%. At 84% the lines fly up staggered (expo.in), the stamp shrinks, the photo irises closed and the footer fades.
adapt: Replace the photo, the three lines, stamp text and palette; keep the 1s expo.inOut iris and 0.15s line offsets.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the photo, lines, stamp and footer; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with iris 0 to 0.2D, lines at 0.1D, exit at 0.84D. Scope selectors to el.
caveats: animated clip-path circle over a filtered image is moderately heavy
